Health Sciences

Maastricht University

← Back to search
About this programme

A reliable curriculum comparison is currently unavailable. The external curriculum has unresolved requirements; no complete degree pathway is certified here.

Maastricht Health Sciences integrates biological, behavioural and environmental perspectives on health. The renewed programme studies healthy generations, changing living environments and climate, and healthcare within society through thematic blocks, projects and research and professional learning lines.

A complete comparison awaits the remaining requirements for the renewed programme introduced in September 2026. The verified subset below contains 60 EC in year one and a 30-EC minor. No UCR programme is presented while the remaining curriculum and thesis allocation is unresolved. This does not establish that a UCR response is impossible.

Academic year: 2026–2027

Verified subset: 90 of 180 EC. The new regulations reserve second- and third-year examination components for later regulations. The earlier Prevention and Health route and its thesis credits do not govern new entrants. First-year portfolios, active participation and progression requirements apply. The 30-EC minor is preserved as profiling space; study outside the faculty requires prior approval.
